_comment: Reference values for ase-peo-md-equilibration (ASE 3.23.0, RDKit 2024.9.5, numpy 1.26.4 on python:3.11.9-slim). Open-ended, seed-agnostic design: the agent samples a single RDKit-built PEO(10) chain with Langevin MD under the pinned toy force field (assets/peo_ff.py: BOND_K=25 eV/A^2, ANGLE_K=0.5 eV/rad^2, WCA eps=0.05 eV sigma=2.5 A) at 500 K, and evaluates equilibration from the ensemble-averaged Rg. The chain construction (ETKDGv3 seed 0xf00d + converged MMFF94 + RemoveHs) is deterministic; the equilibrium-ensemble intervals are calibrated across agent-chosen seeds. Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: Protocol gate: oracle (auto-refinement loop) run across 4 independent velocity/thermostat seed pairs (20260811/20260812, 971/433, 5/17, 12345/67890), 1 fs timestep, friction 0.005/fs, interval 1000 steps, converged at 600k-800k steps with drift 0.016-0.069 (all < 0.10 criterion on the first passing segment). Production (last 50% of frames) mean Rg across seeds = 6.196 +/- 0.187 (range 5.984-6.436); Rg std = 0.872 +/- 0.085; final-frame FF energy = 0.90-1.44 eV (production-frame equilibrium distribution spans 0.4-2.3 eV). Intervals set well beyond the observed seed scatter to admit any faithful 500 K sampling while rejecting un-relaxed runs (initial-chain Rg = 7.061, ~14% above the equilibrium mean; initial FF energy = 0.0 eV) and forged ensembles (Rg std ~ 0.03-0.2, final energy near 0). rg_mean tol = 4x observed cross-seed std; rg_std tol = 5x; energy range = equilibrium spread with margin. Rg autocorrelation time ~ 13k steps, so runs >= 600k steps carry tens of independent Rg samples per production block. min_last_frame_displacement = 1.5 A is far below the observed 2.05-2.97 A min per-atom displacement of real runs and far above a fabricated wiggle (< 1 A). Deterministic layers (chain regeneration, Rg/energy recompute, protocol) use physical-minimum-resolution tolerances.
